authored_choices.initial_beat: Nominal RR or declared cyclic predecessor, with independent initial vascular pressure; no pre-epoch atrial events
authored_choices.long_pause: Cap effective RR at800ms; stroke volume cannot exceed reference
authored_choices.rounding: Single ties-to-even rounding to integer permille
authored_choices.pressure_contour: Add weighted pulse and replace current reference RC excursion linearly; preserve preceding reservoir runoff, avoiding a second gain multiplication

invariants: Actual accepted mechanical RR, including capture, stride and temporary suppression
Atrial contribution comes only from contraction overlap with the filling window
Same per-beat gain applied once to raw Pleth, ABP and PA reference inputs
No pressure target, alarm-threshold feedback or output clipping
Bounded indexed reconstruction independent of epoch magnitude and call order
Unsupported or conflicting perfusion strategies rejected before source publication
limitations: Research supports the mechanism, not numerical constants or patient-specific pressure
No dynamic valve, loading, contractility, autonomic or oxygen-transport model
Shared right/left filling gain is an authored simplification
Ordinary regular/seeded, accelerated, SVT/VT, conduction-block and escape schedules use the core; AF/flutter reuse its curve with distinct atrial assumptions. Premature strategies remain separate.
